title: Act: Add restricted-permission flags to Claude.Run
summary: Build the claude args with permission mode and tool allow/deny lists
description: Replace the inline []string{"-p", claudePrompt} in Claude.Run with a package-level builder claudeArgs() returning flags that restrict the CLI.
acceptance_criteria: Run passes --disallowedTools Bash,WebFetch,WebSearch and an --allowedTools list without Bash

steps.action: Add function claudeArgs() []string returning -p, claudePrompt, --permission-mode, acceptEdits, --allowedTools, Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep, --disallowedTools, Bash,WebFetch,WebSearch.
Change the Exec call to pass claudeArgs() instead of the inline []string{"-p", claudePrompt}.
steps.code: c.exec.Run(ctx, workDir, "claude", []string{"-p", claudePrompt}) -> c.exec.Run(ctx, workDir, "claude", claudeArgs())
steps.expected: Exec receives the restricted flag list.
